descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S05 「真实模型上 Save & Extract 的结果表：对上的、没对上的、还在等的、重复说的、有条件的、监测的、撤回、给过的药、床旁检查、待办」 Save & Extract outcome table on the live model: matched, unmatched, still pending, restated, conditional, monitoring, retraction, given medication, bedside check, action item

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing, once and with no duplicates, leaves unmatched tasks open, and records the dictated medication events.（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 2；TFA-92592 rule 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T1 Save & Extract extracts conditional orders ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') and monitoring-phrased physician orders as tasks; retractions ('leave glargine at 20') are not.（TFA-92592 AC 3；UAT TC-22） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 A medication already given ('restarted metoprolol this morning') is documented as performed, not re-ordered.（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Bedside checks stay reminders, not findings: 'check for dysuria' never becomes 'reports dysuria'.（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-14 step 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Each mode's fixture patient has five open tasks and two tracker rows (seed below)

When Type the dictation into the encounter box and press Save & Extract, once per mode

Then C1 'BMP came back' closes 'Follow up BMP' once. C2 'PT saw her' closes 'PT eval' once. C3 'Wound care consult' (not mentioned) stays open. C4 the conditional diet order becomes one new task. C5 'leave glargine at 20' adds no task and leaves the glargine row unchanged. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Backend probe after each checkpoint (rounding:get / snf:get): BMP and PT eval done; Wound care consult, Follow up blood cultures and Recheck weight in two weeks open; exactly one new task matching each of 'clears', 'potassium' and 'urine culture'; countMatching('weight') = 1; no task matching 'glargine' or 'metoprolol'; glargine row unchanged; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
